summary.oneLiner: Manufacturer and marketer of welding consumables and allied welding equipment and appliances, serving India's infrastructure, construction, power, oil & gas, shipbuilding, railways and heavy-engineering sectors.
summary.business: GEE Limited manufactures and deals in all kinds of welding consumables and allied equipment and appliances, with no change in the nature of its business during the year. The Company's operations are considered under a single reportable business segment in accordance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards, serving customers across infrastructure, construction, power, oil & gas, shipbuilding, railways, heavy engineering and manufacturing sectors.
